## Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Provenance and security review

- [ ] Identify full source revisions and relevant upstream changes.
- [ ] Review new/changed dependencies, build steps and network destinations.
- [ ] Trace credential handling through storage, requests, logs, diagnostics and MQTT.
- [ ] Preserve the documented host-trust boundary and disclose changed permissions.
- [ ] Include no real cookies, keys, tokens, contacts, locations or host reports.

## Validation

Record exact commands/results and relevant limitations. A reviewed source change does not automatically authorize deployment.

## Deployment

State whether deployment is needed and provide a concrete rollback. Never automatically sync upstream or deploy unaudited changes.
